recorded: Every case passed 10 runs against the unchanged original with Node.js 26.12.1, npm 12.2.1, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.27.1, zod 3.25.76, and tsx 4.21.0, and with Verdaccio 6.11.1 from the module's compose file under a container name of its own, still published on port 4873, where the release script publishes, which must be free. Each case names its program, and one shell command run from the module chose by it: start ran node src/index.ts, the file npm start runs with type stripping, release ran npm publish --registry http://localhost:4873, the half of npm run release:private after npm version patch, so the cases publish 0.0.2 and change nothing in the folder, and published ran npx -y --registry http://localhost:4873 @erickwendel/customers-mcp@latest, the commented line of .vscode/mcp.json with this version's package name, as an MCP client starts it. npm's cache was emptied before each run, so npx installed the package and its dependencies from the registry every time. The registry stands in for a private one without accounts: its configuration lets anyone install and publish the @erickwendel scope, which it never looks up on the public registry, where 0.0.2 already exists, and proxies every other package from registry.npmjs.org. npm publish asks for a token even so, so the command passed a placeholder for //localhost:4873/ instead of running npm run registry:login:private. The server is lesson 07's: it requires SERVICE_TOKEN and always calls the customers API at http://localhost:9999/v1 with it as a bearer, so the cases put the replay on port 9999, which must be free, and every recorded answer requires the case's token in the Authorization header. Every answer was recorded from this lesson's API, nodejs-fastify-mongodb-crud-z, on an empty MongoDB, so their ObjectIds are fixed. The customers' answers came with a service token it issued to the admin erickwendel, which the SERVICE_TOKEN of the file stands for, the one this version's .vscode/mcp.json sets, and the refusals with a token it never issued, a service token it issued to the member ananeri, and an admin service token that had already spent its 90 requests of the minute. Texts that hold JSON are compared by value, so spacing and key order are free. Tools and the prompt's arguments are compared in any order, the prompt's arguments by name and description, since an optional argument may leave out required, and capabilities by presence. A refused call comes back as a result whose structuredContent holds isError true and the message the text repeats, with the result's own isError false or left out, never true. A lookup that finds nothing breaks the output schema, which has no null customer, so the SDK answers it with isError, and the case also accepts any JSON-RPC error or a null customer from SDKs that do not check their output. Invalid arguments and unknown tools may come back as a tool result with isError or as a JSON-RPC error with code -32602. The release case reads the package back from the registry and compares its name, its latest tag, and the name of its executable, while the path the executable points to is free.
originals: case {program} in start) node src/index.ts ;; release) npm publish --registry http://localhost:4873 --//localhost:4873/:_authToken=stackfy ;; published) npx -y --registry http://localhost:4873 @erickwendel/customers-mcp@latest ;; esac

services.up:
docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f - -p stackfy-08-publishing-mcp up -d --wait verdaccio <<'EOF'
services:
  verdaccio:
    container_name: stackfy-08-publishing-mcp-verdaccio
    configs:
      - source: verdaccio
        target: /verdaccio/conf/config.yaml
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'wget', '-q', '-O', '/dev/null', 'http://127.0.0.1:4873/-/ping']
      interval: 1s
      retries: 60
configs:
  verdaccio:
    content: |
      storage: /verdaccio/storage/data
      uplinks:
        npmjs:
          url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
      packages:
        '@erickwendel/*':
          access: $$all
          publish: $$all
        '**':
          access: $$all
          proxy: npmjs
EOF
